parsed.why: No trans offence; hate-speech and discrimination protections cover gender identity; self-declaration recognition. Downside: record hate crimes, falling clearance, low reporting, extremist hostility — but state responded with maximum sentence and condemnation.

Federal gender-identity protection with 2024 damages ruling, 2025 hate-crime law, lived-gender prison placement, no sodomy law. Friction over facilities and records, but organised exclusion meets working courts and enforcement remedies.

Uncodified sharia treats gender nonconformity itself as crime; death penalty available, cross-dressing arrests, custody death of a trans woman, airport arrest over posts, deportation of foreigners. State is perpetrator, not protector.

Decriminalised 2022, but no discrimination law, no gender recognition, no unions, LGBTQ avoid law enforcement, dated official exclusion posture. No documented trans-specific targeting or violence — thin data in a socially conservative record.

Sodomy statute actively used by police as extortion lever, forced examinations, police named foremost violators; prison placement defaults to birth sex. Mitigated by gender-recognition certificates, limited prosecutions, mixed but partly supportive official posture.
